centered.name: 居中对称
centered.zh: 版式居中对称：品牌和导航居中排在顶部，插图缩成标题上方的一枚徽记，标题、正文、特点、数字全部居中
centered.en: centered symmetrical layout: brand and menu centered at the top, the illustration shrunk into an emblem above the headline, and headline, copy, features and numbers all center-aligned

vertical.name: 竖排
vertical.zh: 版式竖排：首屏左边是大幅插图，右边标题和正文从右往左竖排，三个特点也竖排
vertical.en: vertical layout: a large illustration on the left of the hero, the headline and copy set vertically right-to-left on the right, and the three features set vertically too

magazine.name: 杂志多栏
magazine.zh: 版式像杂志：栏目名下压细线，大标题横跨整版，正文分两栏加栏线，插图放在右下，特点之间用竖线分栏，数字区上下各一条线
magazine.en: magazine layout: a ruled section label, a headline spanning the full width, body copy in two columns with a column rule, the illustration at the lower right, features divided by vertical rules and the numbers framed by rules above and below

split.name: 左右分屏
split.zh: 版式左右分屏：插图占满左边一整条（从页头到页脚），右边单列排导航、标题、特点、数字和页脚
split.en: split layout: the illustration fills a full-height strip on the left, and the right column stacks navigation, headline, features, numbers and footer

poster.name: 海报大字
poster.zh: 版式像海报：插图铺满首屏当背景，超大标题压在上面靠下对齐，三个特点改成一条条横排清单
poster.en: poster layout: the illustration fills the hero as a background, an oversized headline sits on top aligned to the bottom, and the three features become a horizontal list of rows

bento.name: 便当格
bento.zh: 版式是便当格：整页拆成大小不一的圆角格子拼在一起，标题一大格、插图一格，三个特点和三个数字各占一格
bento.en: bento layout: the page is a grid of tiles of different sizes, with a large tile for the headline, one for the illustration, and one each for the three features and three numbers

sidebar.name: 侧栏导航
sidebar.zh: 版式带侧栏：导航竖着放在左边一整条（品牌在上、菜单往下排），右边是内容
sidebar.en: sidebar layout: navigation runs down a full-height strip on the left (brand at the top, menu below), with the content on the right

me-centered.name: 居中名片
me-centered.zh: 版式是居中名片：头像放大居中在最上面，名字、一句话介绍、标签和文章标题全部居中排
me-centered.en: centered card layout: a large avatar centered at the top, with the name, one-line bio, tags and post titles all center-aligned

me-sidebar.name: 侧栏名片
me-sidebar.zh: 版式带侧栏名片：左边一整条放头像、名字、介绍和标签，右边是导航、文章列表和近况
me-sidebar.en: sidebar profile layout: a full-height left column holds the avatar, name, bio and tags, while navigation, the post list and a now section sit on the right

me-cards.name: 卡片网格
me-cards.zh: 版式是卡片网格：文章做成三张并排的卡片，每张上面一块封面色块，下面是日期、标题、摘要和标签
me-cards.en: card grid layout: posts become three side-by-side cards, each with a cover block on top and the date, title, excerpt and tag below

me-timeline.name: 时间线
me-timeline.zh: 版式是时间线：文章挂在一条竖线上，每篇一个圆点，日期写在线的左边
me-timeline.en: timeline layout: posts hang on a vertical line with a dot for each entry and the dates on the left of the line

me-magazine.name: 杂志头条
me-magazine.zh: 版式像杂志：名字做成横跨整版的刊头，头像缩小放在介绍旁；第一篇文章做大头条，另外两篇在下面并排
me-magazine.en: magazine layout: the name becomes a full-width masthead with a small avatar beside the bio; the first post is a large lead story and the other two sit side by side below

me-hero.name: 大字首屏
me-hero.zh: 版式是大字首屏：首屏只有超大的名字和一句介绍，头像缩成右上角一枚圆章，文章在下面分两列
me-hero.en: big-type hero layout: the first screen holds only an oversized name and a one-line bio, the avatar shrinks to a round badge at the top right, and posts follow in two columns

me-index.name: 目录索引
me-index.zh: 版式是文字目录：名字和介绍一行带过，文章只留「日期、标题、标签」一行一条，不放摘要
me-index.en: text index layout: the name and bio take a single line, and each post is one row of date, title and tag with no excerpt

me-bento.name: 便当格
me-bento.zh: 版式是便当格：头像一格、名字和介绍一大格，三篇文章和近况各占一格，格子圆角大小不一
me-bento.en: bento layout: the avatar in one tile, the name and bio in a large tile, and each of the three posts and the now section in its own rounded tile
